dataset_origin: Real Colombian Agroclimatic Dataset (AGROSAVIA + UPRA EVA + DANE DIVIPOLA + NASA POWER)

sources.climatology: NASA POWER Climatology API (community=AG: T2M, RH2M, PRECTOTCORR)

selection_rationale: Outperformed synthetic baseline (Silhouette 0.2402 vs 0.0986, Purity 55.71% vs 17.50%, ARI 0.2698 vs 0.0000) and beat SCARF contrastive embeddings (Silhouette 0.2006, ARI 0.0859) and PowerTransformer (Silhouette 0.1893, ARI 0.2064) on internal geometry and ARI while preserving exact Z-score geometry for OOD calibration.
